rationale: The proposed topology adds a source degeneration inductor to improve input matching and reduce noise, addressing the severe NF and S11 violations while maintaining low power and gain. The inductor provides reactance to resonate with input capacitance, enhancing S11 and shifting the input impedance toward 50Ω, which directly improves both NF and S11. The inductor also increases the effective source impedance, reducing noise figure by suppressing thermal noise from the gate. The addition is minimal and fits within the device budget and inductor limit.
